title: Lake Escapes Boat Rentals
specs: Premium, fully loaded boats with world class award winning surf systems and top of the line sports gear
Includes high quality Obrien tubes, vests, wake boards, and surf boards at no extra cost
Driver's license required to sign electronic contract at launch
Pets, smoking, and vaping prohibited on all boats
Seating ranges from 16 to 19 passengers on wake surf boats depending on model
includes: Free surf boards, tubes, wake boards, and skis (pontoon only) with every rental
blurb: Guests rent premium quality boats including wake surf boats, pontoons with water slides, and jet skis. Rentals include free water toys such as surf boards, tubes, wake boards, and skis (pontoon only). Boats are delivered to lakes within a 100+ mile radius of Spokane and Coeur d'Alene.
extraNote: $1,500 damage deposit authorized on credit card at delivery, cancelled if boat returned in good order · Daily Damage Waiver fee charged at booking covering first $1,500 of damages except for pets, smoking, vaping, or fishing damage · No pets allowed; $150 fee plus $75/hour cleaning fee if pets detected · Boats delivered by company; no customer pickup service · Fuel provided full; return full or charged cost plus $50 · Launch locations vary; guests should arrive 10-20 minutes early at the launch for orientation and check-in. · Operating season includes peak season June 20th to September 10th with some rental restrictions during peak.
